note: Twelve items, 100 points. Score each honestly; most first-pass profiles land in the 30s and 40s. The name, the bio and the pinned three weigh most: they are what a stranger arriving from one video reads before deciding to follow.

items.full_marks: The display name carries the name plus what the account is about in words people search ("Dana Ruiz | Proposal templates"). It is the bold line above the handle and is searchable.
items.common_fail: Just a name, or a name with an emoji.

items.full_marks: The bio is short on TikTok; its first line names who this is for and what changes for them, in their words.
The rest of the bio carries one proof or one offer and reads as words, not a pipe-separated list.
Up to three pinned videos doing three different jobs: the best proof, the clearest explanation of the offer, the best introduction to the person.
items.common_fail: Nothing pinned, so the top of the grid is whatever was posted last.

items.full_marks: When the account has the bio link option, one link to one destination that matches the bio promise.
items.common_fail: A link hub with ten buttons, or no link where one is available.

items.full_marks: Playlists (or series) group the videos a newcomer should binge, named by what they get.
Covers carry a readable title, so the grid explains itself at thumbnail size.
A clear face or mark that reads at the small circle size.
items.common_fail: A busy photo or a tiny logo.

items.full_marks: The handle is easy to say and spell, and matches the name used elsewhere.
items.common_fail: Underscores and numbers nobody can remember.

items.full_marks: A business or creator account shows a way to make contact when the account sells something.
items.common_fail: An offer in the bio and no way to reach the person.

items.full_marks: Posted in the last 7 days and at a steady pace (the audit cadence shows it).
items.common_fail: A gap of weeks at the top of the grid.

items.full_marks: Replies to comments, stories or LIVE show a person behind the account.
items.common_fail: Only polished uploads, no sign of a person.
